claims.action: lived by mother tomb three years
blocked Guizhou land survey using Bao Chengzuo precedent
defended Zhang Yin and was demoted

translationRepairs: When severe flooding and famine struck, he worked with the governor-general to organize relief and saved many lives.
When severe flooding and famine struck, he worked with the governor to organize relief and saved many lives.
s0122 has 與巡撫籌賑務; 巡撫 is the provincial governor (xunfu), not governor-general (總督). The proposed 'governor' correctly restores the office named in the Chinese.

Earlier, when Zongfang was educational commissioner in Guizhou, the governor-general proposed surveying all land in the province to increase taxation, terrifying the populace. When educational officials were ordered to collect documents, he found a memorial by Censor Bao Chengzuo. In the early Qianlong reign, Educational Commissioner Zou Yigui had requested land surveys, but Chengzuo had memorialized in rebuttal, arguing that Guizhou had more mountains than flat land, that people often falsely claimed barren plots, that clerks manipulated the process, that surveying uneven terrain would not necessarily increase revenue, and that the people would suffer.

Earlier, when Zongfang was educational commissioner in Guizhou, the governor proposed surveying all land in the province to increase taxation, terrifying the populace. When educational officials were ordered to collect documents, he found a memorial by Censor Bao Chengzuo. In the early Qianlong reign, Educational Commissioner Zou Yigui had requested land surveys, but Chengzuo had memorialized in rebuttal, arguing that Guizhou had more mountains than flat land, that people often falsely claimed barren plots, that clerks manipulated the process, that surveying uneven terrain would not necessarily increase revenue, and that the people would suffer.

s0124 has 巡撫議丈全省田; the proposer of the Guizhou land survey is a 巡撫 (governor), not a 總督. Replacing governor-general with governor matches the Chinese and leaves the rest of the accurate human wording intact.
The ministry deliberated and halted the plan. Zongfang showed the document to the governor-general and said: "An educational commissioner once memorialized on this matter and was rejected.
The ministry deliberated and halted the plan. Zongfang showed the document to the governor and said: "An educational commissioner once memorialized on this matter and was rejected.
s0125 has 持以示巡撫曰; Zongfang showed the memorial to the 巡撫. Governor-general would be 總督, which is absent; 'governor' is the correct title.
The governor-general understood as well, and the matter was dropped.
The governor understood as well, and the matter was dropped.
s0127 begins 巡撫亦悟; the official who understood and dropped the matter is again the 巡撫. The proposed 'governor' corrects the false elevation to governor-general.

By then serving in the Ministry of Revenue, he found that acting governor-general Lin Qing had again memorialized on the matter. The ministry cited precedent in a detailed reply, and the proposal was finally rejected.

By then serving in the Ministry of Revenue, he found that acting governor Lin Qing had again memorialized on the matter. The ministry cited precedent in a detailed reply, and the proposal was finally rejected.
s0128 has 署巡撫麟慶; Lin Qing was acting 巡撫 (acting governor), not acting governor-general. The proposed wording correctly renders 署巡撫.

Soon after, Jiangxi Governor-General Yu Tai impeached and dismissed Nanchang Prefect Zhang Yin. Yuanzhi memorialized in Zhang's defense, enumerating his achievements and requesting an investigation. The emperor rebuked him for presumption and demoted him two grades for reassignment.

Soon after, Jiangxi Governor Yu Tai impeached and dismissed Nanchang Prefect Zhang Yin. Yuanzhi memorialized in Zhang's defense, enumerating his achievements and requesting an investigation. The emperor rebuked him for presumption and demoted him two grades for reassignment.
s0148 has 江西巡撫裕泰; Yu Tai is identified as Jiangxi 巡撫 (provincial governor), not 總督. 'Jiangxi Governor' is the accurate title; the rest of the sentence is sound.
Appointed governor-general of Shanxi, within a month he was recalled to serve as acting vice minister of Personnel and ordered to serve under the Grand Council ministers.
Appointed governor of Shanxi, within a month he was recalled to serve as acting vice minister of Personnel and ordered to serve under the Grand Council ministers.
s0208 has 授山西巡撫; the appointment is to Shanxi 巡撫 (governor), not governor-general. The proposed 'governor of Shanxi' matches the Chinese office.
After his death, the Ministry of War sent Qing Lian to the military metropolitan examination despite his physical disability, and he was impeached by the supervising censor.
After his death, the Ministry of War sent Qing Lian to the military metropolitan examination despite his physical disability, and the responsible officials were impeached by the supervising censor.

In s0081, 兵部以慶廉送武會試有殘疾，為監試御史所劾, the passive 為監試御史所劾 attaches to the Ministry of War's improper sending of the disabled candidate, not to Qing Lian as impeached person. English 'he was impeached' wrongly makes Qing Lian the target; 'the responsible officials were impeached' restores the correct patient of 劾, and s0082's contrast with Na Qingan's earlier disqualification of Qing Lian confirms that reading.
